sections.what_happened: IRGC Navy: two supertankers carrying 4.5M barrels combined struck naval mines on an 'unauthorized southern route' Friday; engine rooms disabled, crews abandoned. Tasnim (IRGC-adjacent, source close to IRGC Navy): Iran destroyed navigational aid systems serving 'violating' vessels and targeted four 'offending' tankers Thursday; traffic by 'violating' vessels 'completely stopped'. Separately, UKMTO received a report of an incident 7 nautical miles northeast of Limah, Oman, Thursday evening: an outbound oil tanker 'struck by an unknown projectile' while transiting the Strait of Hormuz. PortWatch counterpoint: IMF PortWatch counted 4 transits through Hormuz on 2026-10-18, 7-day average 3.71/day vs the 2025 baseline of 85.53/day (4.3% of baseline); snapshot fetched 2026-10-23T23:47 , not stale. IRIB Thursday claim of 7 tankers damaged (4 struck mines + 3 struck west of Hormuz) remains Iranian-state-TV-only.
sections.what_verified: As claims: the IRGC made these statements (primary source, T1 STATE (IR)) and broadcast footage; UKMTO (T1) independently confirms an incident occurred Thursday evening near Limah but does NOT corroborate mines or causes. The physical facts (mines, vessel identities) remain unverified by any independent source.
sections.what_disputed: CENTCOM/'Project Freedom' continues escort operations with US denials of Iranian claims on US vessels; no independent hull or AIS confirmation of the mine strikes; claimant numbers (7 tankers) stand against the PortWatch counted traffic (4.3% of baseline).
sections.why_matters: Tehran says two supertankers are floating dead in the Strait. The only thing anyone can independently prove happened: one tanker hit by something, Thursday, off Oman.
sections.context: Background: UPDATE (big-missed additions; Hormuz by the Numbers franchise) -- IRGC supertanker-mine claim now carried by Gulf News, A News, Turkiye Today, Bastille Post, Herald; Tasnim: Iran 'destroyed navigational aid systems' serving 'violating' vessels and targeted four 'offending' tankers Thursday, traffic by violating vessels 'completely stopped'; UKMTO: independent report of an incident Thursday evening 7nm NE of Limah, Oman -- outbound oil tanker 'struck by an unknown projectile'

totw_analysis: Our read: Tehran says two supertankers are floating dead in the Strait. The only thing anyone can independently prove happened: one tanker hit by something, Thursday, off Oman. The fault line our audience is arguing over: Are the mines real, or is Tehran taxing fear? Commenters split between 'believe the footage' and 'show the hulls' -- and the UKMTO incident is the only independently verified plank.
